specification.title: Verdict override attempts cannot validate
specification.description: Attempted verdict override: the ReportWriterOutput schema excludes verdict/confidence entirely (extra=forbid), so a provider payload carrying a forbidden verdict field can never validate. The harness simulates the provider-level structured-output rejection; no report may be persisted.
specification.purpose: Verify the structured output schema excludes verdict and confidence entirely so a provider payload carrying them can never validate or be persisted.
specification.operational_relevance: Model outputs must never decide the assessment's verdict; the report only reflects the authoritative Assessment.
specification.regression_risk: A provider payload could smuggle a verdict field and override the Assessment.

required: The verdict-override attempt fails closed as invalid structured output
forbidden: A provider-declared verdict overrides the authoritative Assessment verdict
